notes.title: Natural Musical Update - More Music, Nature, and Features! 🎶🌿
notes.content:
[list]
[*] 🎵 [b]More Music[/b]: Immerse yourself with new tracks, including contextual music and catchy jingles to set the mood.
[*] 🌲 [b]More Nature[/b]: Goldie’s world gets a lush update with added natural elements to explore and enjoy.
[*] 💥 [b]Working Monster Projectiles[/b]: Monsters are stepping up their game—watch out for their functioning projectiles!
[*] 💾[b] Updated Save System[/b]: Saving your progress is now more reliable and efficient.
[*] 📜 [b]New About Page[/b]: Learn more about the game and its creators directly from the in-game menu.
[/list]

notes.title: Animate Everything!
notes.content:
This update is all about animations! 🎉

From subtle touches to epic movements, we’ve added animations everywhere. A little motion here, a little motion there… and a lot more motion everywhere.

Because everything looks better when it moves, right?

notes.title: Darker, Starter, Lighter
notes.content:
[b]More Dark![/b]
Have you ever seen a plain white background instead of an epic animation? Not anymore! Background movies are now sharper, smarter, and, of course, darker.

[b]Starting Checkpoint[/b]
Yes, really! We’ve heard you. Some players were dying (a lot) even on the first map, and restarting from the intro movie wasn’t fun. Now, you can resume directly from the starting checkpoint. Brilliant, right?

[b]Losing Weight[/b]
No, we’re not talking about Goldie or Silva – it’s the game itself! We’ve optimized it to take up significantly less space on your awesome hard drive. You’re welcome!

notes.title: Update 0.17 is Here! QuestsLog, AssetsRefill, AutoDialogs, and More! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello adventurers!

We’re thrilled to roll out Version 0.17, packed with exciting new features and improvements to enhance your gameplay experience. Here’s what’s new:

📝 QuestLog - Your Ultimate Adventure Companion
No more feeling lost or wondering what to do next! The brand-new QuestLog keeps track of your objectives and helps guide you through your journey. Whether you’re tackling main quests or side missions, this significant UX upgrade ensures you’ll always know your next steps.

💬 AutoDialogs - A Smoother NPC Interaction Experience
Say goodbye to endless clicking during NPC conversations! With AutoDialogs, dialogue flows naturally, making your interactions feel seamless and immersive. Of course, you can still manually skip or read at your own pace, but now the story progresses effortlessly.

🎨 Assets Refill - World-Building Just Got Better
We’ve added tons of new assets to fill the gaps and bring the world to life. Expect richer environments, polished visuals, and exciting new details to discover. Plus, we’re introducing new music tracks to elevate the atmosphere and immerse you even deeper in the game!
